output.reason: The release note says 1.13 "changes the defaults to disable the policy exceptions" [ev-2bd1a74f9c4a], and the upgrade guide says the chart values used to enable exceptions by default [ev-dea2079e5dc4]. Nothing in the evidence describes a default inside the PolicyException CRD's spec, so the subject crd-field PolicyException.spec is wrong. The chart renders show what actually changed: the default of the --enablePolicyException argument on the admission, background and reports controllers went from true to false [ev-b39e8c27b4a6][ev-e599ee1bf192][ev-89fe173dc4ac][ev-87f3f8d70a09][ev-f85ade3c8a00]. The proposed change (default-changed, true → false) is correct for that flag, so only the subject needs correcting.

correction.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 disables policy exceptions by default: the chart's default for --enablePolicyException changes from true to false on the admission, background and reports controllers. Exceptions are also limited to a specified namespace (CVE-2024-48921).
